# يَنْحَلِبُ (yanḥalibu) /jan.ħa.li.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)

# يَنْحَلِبْ (yanḥalib) /jan.ħa.lib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
